note: Set A repeats the same handrail and cladding material claims several times and includes a vague bare 'flatbar | material | steel' claim, while omitting the elevation dimensions entirely. Set B is more compact and captures the finished-floor-to-grade dimension (2'-9 1/2") correctly. However, B misbinds 18'-0" as a finished-floor-to-solar-envelope height, whereas the drawing labels it as the solar envelope elevation above grade level. Despite that one misbinding, B's coverage of the height facts and lack of redundant claims make it the stronger set.
